attributes.board_name: Oklahoma State Board of Examiners of Psychologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: CPE approved by the Board or a recognized sponsor; activities approved by the Oklahoma Psychological Association (OPA), APA or ASPPB are automatically approved. One clock hour = one credit; presenters earn 3 credits per hour presented
rules.carryover: Up to 12 hours may be carried forward to the next renewal year.
rules.notes: CPE calendar year Jan 1 - Dec 31; CPE credits are entered in the Board's online renewal system (renewal window Oct 15 - Dec 31). License becomes invalid Jan 1 if not renewed.
rules.legal_basis: Oklahoma Administrative Code Title 575 (Board rules); Psychologists Licensing Act
